description: Configuration and tokenizer files of Stable Diffusion 2.1 Base (unet, vae, text_encoder and scheduler configs, CLIP tokenizer) from the ungated community re-host sd2-community/stable-diffusion-2-1-base at 4e63672c, with no weights. The CHORD checkpoint carries the full UNet, VAE and text-encoder weights; its code builds those modules from these configs and loads the tokenizer. The creator's own source, RedbeardNZ/stable-diffusion-2-1-base, no longer exists on Hugging Face and the original Stability AI repository is gone, so this mirror's bytes stand in. CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M.
